dosing_regimen.source_excerpt: protocolSection.armsInterventionsModule.interventions and armGroups: "Lebrikizumab" "Lebrikizumab solution for injection administered subcutaneously." "Part 1: Open label (Lebrikizumab)" "Part 2: Double-Blind (Lebrikizumab)" "Part 2: Open label Escape Arm (Lebrikizumab)" "Part 2: Open label Run-In Period (Lebrikizumab)" "Placebo" "Lebrikizumab Matching placebo solution for injection administered subcutaneously." "Part 2: Double-Blind (Placebo)" "Participants with moderate-to-severe AD will receive loading doses of lebrikizumab 500 mg SC injection (2 injections) at Day 1 and Week 2 followed by 250 mg (1 injection) every 2 weeks (Q2W) after Week 4 to Week 16 followed by 250 mg (1 injection) every 4 weeks (Q4W) after Week 16 to Week 24." "Participants who respond to lebrikizumab treatment at Week 24 of Part 1 will continue treatment in Part 2, which includes an 8-week open-label Run-In Period to confirm sustained clinical response." "During this period, they will receive lebrikizumab 250 mg SC injection (1 injection) Q4W starting from the Week 24 visit of Part 1." "At the end of the Run-In Period, participants who demonstrate sustained clinical response will continue treatment in the double-blind period." "They will either receive lebrikizumab 250 mg SC injection (1 injection) Q4W or switch to lebrikizumab 500 mg SC injection (2 injections) Q12W for 36 weeks." "They will either receive lebrikizumab matching placebo 250 mg SC injection (1 injection) Q4W or switch to lebrikizumab matching placebo 500 mg SC injection (2 injections) Q12W for 36 weeks." "Participants who do not maintain at least a 50% reduction in EASI from baseline (EASI 50) during Double-Blind Period will enter an Escape Arm, in which participants are treated with open label lebrikizumab 250 mg SC injection Q4W." "Study drug treatment will be discontinued in participants entering the Escape Arm who do not maintain an EASI 50 response." "BIOLOGICAL" "OTHER" -- The intervention names and descriptions are copied verbatim from the registry. The registered arm descriptions state multiple doses and frequencies across phases and arms: Part 1 uses 500 mg loading doses on Day 1 and Week 2, then 250 mg Q2W after Week 4 through Week 16 and 250 mg Q4W after Week 16 through Week 24; the 8-week run-in starts at the Week 24 visit with 250 mg Q4W; double-blind treatment is 250 mg Q4W or 500 mg Q12W for 36 weeks, with matching placebo schedules; the escape arm is open-label 250 mg Q4W. Because this Intervention schema has only one dose and frequency per intervention and does not bind dosing_periods to a dose, those varying values are left null rather than collapsed into a misleading single regimen. The false placebo flag for Lebrikizumab follows its registry type BIOLOGICAL; the true placebo flag follows the registry intervention name Placebo and the arm type PLACEBO_COMPARATOR.

study_schedule.source_excerpt: protocolSection.armsInterventionsModule.armGroups[0-3].description: "Participants with moderate-to-severe AD will receive loading doses of lebrikizumab 500 mg SC injection (2 injections) at Day 1 and Week 2 followed by 250 mg (1 injection) every 2 weeks (Q2W) after Week 4 to Week 16 followed by 250 mg (1 injection) every 4 weeks (Q4W) after Week 16 to Week 24." "Participants who respond to lebrikizumab treatment at Week 24 of Part 1 will continue treatment in Part 2, which includes an 8-week open-label Run-In Period to confirm sustained clinical response." "During this period, they will receive lebrikizumab 250 mg SC injection (1 injection) Q4W starting from the Week 24 visit of Part 1." "They will either receive lebrikizumab 250 mg SC injection (1 injection) Q4W or switch to lebrikizumab 500 mg SC injection (2 injections) Q12W for 36 weeks." "They will either receive lebrikizumab matching placebo 250 mg SC injection (1 injection) Q4W or switch to lebrikizumab matching placebo 500 mg SC injection (2 injections) Q12W for 36 weeks." -- Part 1 is described through Week 24; the 8-week open-label run-in starts at the Week 24 visit, so its end is Week 32. The 36-week double-blind period follows that run-in, ending at Week 68 by exact addition (24 + 8 + 36). Registry arm descriptions provide narrative periods, not a per-visit schedule table; full_visit_table_available is false. Visit cadence, clinic visit days, endpoint week anchoring, and total participation duration are not established by these selected descriptions.

value.rationale: Participants who lose EASI 50 during double-blind treatment enter an escape arm receiving open-label lebrikizumab 250 mg SC Q4W; study drug is discontinued for escape participants who do not maintain EASI 50. The registry does not state the escape duration or an ordinal visit rule.

rescue_therapy.source_excerpt: protocolSection.armsInterventionsModule.armGroups[4].description: "Participants who do not maintain at least a 50% reduction in EASI from baseline (EASI 50) during Double-Blind Period will enter an Escape Arm, in which participants are treated with open label lebrikizumab 250 mg SC injection Q4W." "Study drug treatment will be discontinued in participants entering the Escape Arm who do not maintain an EASI 50 response." -- This is a response-triggered escape regimen. The supplied registry text does not state the duration of escape, consecutive-visit requirements, or handling of visits after discontinuation.
